item.title: Data and Analytics
item.dc:creator: colleen.bernum@momentivestg.wpenginepowered.com
item.content:encoded:
Actionable insights. Smarter decisions.

A unified analytics platform designed to empower organizations with data-driven insights for measurable results.

Speak with an Expert

Trusted by organizations worldwide

Join over 4,000+ organizations using Nucleus to make smarter, data-driven decisions.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Leverage actionable insights with Nucleus to make smarter decisions.
Nucleus simplifies workflows and delivers actionable insights that drive measurable results. Discover how we can help your organization thrive.

Nucleus is more than just a data analytics tool—it’s your partner in turning insights into action. With features designed to simplify workflows, uncover trends, and centralize data, Nucleus empowers your organization to achieve measurable results. Here’s how we help:

item.content:encoded:
Create engaging events with lasting impact

Explore our event management solutions for a seamless event experience – for everyone. Speak with an Expert

Trusted by event professionals worldwide

Organizations worldwide rely on Momentive to grow, engage, and achieve their missions.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Simplify event planning and create unforgettable experiences.
Take your event to the next level

Create meaningful event experiences with Momentive's event solutions built to minimize your pre-planning workload and save your staff time. If you’re ready to explore event solutions or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.
We designed our event solutions to save time, boost engagement, maximize your ROI and transform the event experience.

item.title: Volunteer Management (OLD)
item.dc:creator: soniya.bajoria@communitybrands.com
item.content:encoded:
Volunteer Management Software for Scheduling & Engagement

Boost volunteer engagement and management with our best-in-class volunteer management software and focus more on your core mission. Speak with an Expert

Trusted by organizations to amplify every volunteer program

Volunteer management software trusted by hundreds of organizations

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Boost volunteer engagement with top-tier management software
Looking for a better way to manage every step of the volunteer journey?
Boost volunteer engagement and management with our best-in-class volunteer management software and amplify every volunteer program.
Save time with our volunteer management system features.
VolunteerMatters is more than just a volunteer management tool — its powerful volunteer onboarding, management, and engagement features connect you more with the people who fuel your mission.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:16:"box-bx-user-plus";s:5:"title";s:21:"Volunteer Recruitment";s:11:"description";s:228:"Get everything from project catalogs to dedicated landing pages and social media tools to boost outreach efforts, along with targeted e-mail and text recruitment to connect volunteers with initiatives they’ll be interested in.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-1";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:19:"box-bx-check-shield";s:5:"title";s:19:"Background Checking";s:11:"description";s:217:"Manage all states of volunteer onboarding, including automating liability waivers, enforcing background checks, managing document verification, facilitating training sessions, integrating reference checks, and more. ";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-2";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:21:"box-bx-comment-detail";s:5:"title";s:22:"Targeted Communication";s:11:"description";s:109:"Access various templates for sending automated texts and e-mails as timely reminders and feedback requests. ";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-3";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:12:"box-bx-happy";s:5:"title";s:20:"Volunteer Engagement";s:11:"description";s:267:"Keep one step ahead with our streamlined self-registration system, where volunteers can search and sign up for opportunities on their own. An automated onboarding workflow handles registration and verification, as well, significantly reducing administrative workload.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-4";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:20:"box-bx-envelope-open";s:5:"title";s:18:"Volunteer Feedback";s:11:"description";s:178:"Our platform makes feedback collection quick and easy. Volunteers will receive a short survey via e-mail with three simple questions after each volunteer assignment is completed.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}}
We’re here to help! Find answers to the most common questions about our volunteer management solution.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:38:"What is volunteer management software?";s:6:"answer";s:407:"Volunteer management software solutions are tools that help purpose-driven organizations find, train, and organize volunteers. It's an online system that helps keep everything from volunteer data to volunteer project reports in a single location, facilitating effective volunteer management. These tools also help volunteers discover new volunteer opportunities and get in touch with organizations directly.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:53:"What is the purpose of a volunteer management system?";s:6:"answer";s:424:"A volunteer management system is a software solution for nonprofit and charitable organizations to effectively recruit, train, engage, and retain their volunteers using a single platform. These systems are also designed to automate volunteer sign-ups, vet potential volunteers, handle various projects simultaneously, generate volunteer performance reports, and streamline communication between organizations and volunteers.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:71:"How does volunteer management software benefit nonprofit organizations?";s:6:"answer";s:433:"Volunteer management software facilitates signing up and getting started as a volunteer for people who wish to work at nonprofit organizations. It also enables organizations to quickly and efficiently enter and organize volunteer data, use volunteer contact details for promoting events, find volunteers with specific skills or interests, track how many volunteers they have recruited, and monitor the progress of volunteer training.";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:44:"Is there a program to track volunteer hours?";s:6:"answer";s:411:"Our volunteer platform offers volunteers the flexibility to check in/sign in using a kiosk or their mobile devices. Some volunteer positions also allow for reporting worked hours in a timesheet fashion. Our volunteer management tool is unique because it tracks and verifies volunteers' locations before allowing check-in. This helps ensure that each volunteer who checks in is indeed at the assignment location.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:37:"How do I create a volunteer database?";s:6:"answer";s:516:"To create a volunteer database, you can use these strategies: 
  • Share your active volunteer programs with people who volunteer continuously.
  • Reach out to volunteers regarding your past events. Show your appreciation and express gratitude. Ask them if they'd like to be part of ongoing and future projects.
  • You can also join hands with another organization that works for similar causes.
  • Try social media outreach and invest in some digital promotional activities.
";}}

a:6:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:61:"What types of fundraising campaigns can I run with GiveSmart?";s:6:"answer";s:167:"With GiveSmart, you can host a variety of campaigns, including auctions, donation drives, peer-to-peer fundraising, ticketed events, and virtual or hybrid fundraisers.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:47:"Can GiveSmart handle hybrid and virtual events?";s:6:"answer";s:170:"Absolutely! Unify donor management, events, and financials

GiveSmart integrates effortlessly with your organization’s workflow, connecting with donor databases, accounting systems, event platforms, and more. Our platform ensures that all your fundraising and financial tools work together seamlessly, saving you time and maximizing your impact.

From recurring giving to peer-to-peer to text-to-give campaigns and more, we've got you covered. We believe in inclusive learning, and our accessibility features work seamlessly behind the scenes to support every member of your learning community. Path LMS breaks down learning barriers by making education accessible to all learners.

Path LMS meets rigorous accessibility standards (Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA) to ensure every user can easily engage with your content. With built-in features like automatic video captioning, screen reader compatibility, and keyboard navigation, Path LMS empowers all your learners to succeed.

a:9:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:35:"What is association event software?";s:6:"answer";s:659:"Association event software is a purpose-built platform designed to help professional associations plan, manage, and execute member events. It can handle annual conferences and trade shows to chapter meetings, webinars, and continuing education programs.
Unlike general event management tools, association event software is built around the specific workflows associations rely on: member pricing, AMS integration, CE credit tracking, and multi-event logistics. It centralizes registration, check-in, attendee tracking, and reporting in one place, so association staff can manage complex event programs without juggling multiple disconnected platforms. ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:58:"How does association event software integrate with an AMS?";s:6:"answer";s:584:"Most association event platforms — including Momentive — offer native integrations with leading association management software systems such as Nimble AMS, NetForum, and YourMembership. These integrations allow event registration data to sync directly into member records, so membership status, pricing tiers, and CE credits are always up to date without manual data entry. Real-time membership verification at registration ensures members receive the correct pricing, while post-event data flows back into the AMS to maintain accurate attendance history and engagement records. ";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:71:"Can Momentive's association event software handle member pricing tiers?";s:6:"answer";s:429:"Yes. Momentive supports multiple registration pricing tiers, including member, non-member, student, and chapter-based pricing — all within a single event registration workflow. Real-time membership verification automatically applies the correct price based on a registrant's current membership status, reducing manual review and pricing errors. It also supports early-bird pricing, coupons, and group registration discounts. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:65:"Does Momentive support CE credit tracking for association events?";s:6:"answer";s:518:"Yes. Momentive's CE credit claiming solution is built for the continuing education workflows associations manage, with board and license issuance reporting included. Members access a personalized web portal to claim credits, complete evaluations, and manage their CE history in one place. Attendee tracking uses session scanning to verify time-in-attendance and award credits accurately, eliminating the errors common with manual sign-in sheets. Reporting tools cover awarded credits by user, session, and course. ";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:73:"What types of events does Momentive's association event software support?";s:6:"answer";s:520:"Momentive supports the full range of association event types including annual conferences, trade shows, chapter meetings, webinars, virtual and hybrid events, and multi-day continuing education programs. The platform is built to scale from small regional gatherings to large national conferences with thousands of attendees. Whether your association runs a single flagship event each year or manages dozens of programs across multiple chapters, Momentive's event management tools adapt to your calendar and complexity. ";}s:6:"item-5";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:61:"What reporting is available for association event organizers?";s:6:"answer";s:756:"Momentive provides real-time reporting and analytics across every stage of your event. Organizers can track registration volume, revenue, session attendance, and member engagement — before, during, and after the event. Reports are exportable for board presentations, post-event analysis, and stakeholder updates.
During the event, live dashboards give staff visibility into check-in progress and session attendance in real time. After the event, that data supports a complete picture of member participation, program performance, and revenue—with filtering and segmentation by membership tier, chapter, and event type. This reporting access gives association professionals the evidence they need to make data-backed decisions for future events. ";}s:6:"item-6";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:95:"What's the difference between association event software and general event management software?";s:6:"answer";s:890:"General event management software is built for a broad range of use cases — conferences, trade shows, corporate meetings — and focuses primarily on logistics like registration and scheduling. Association event software is purpose-built for the specific workflows associations rely on: member pricing, AMS integration, CE credit tracking, and multi-chapter event management.
The key differences are in what happens around the event itself. Association event software connects event data to your AMS and member records, applies the correct pricing tier based on real-time membership verification, and supports CE credit claiming and reporting that general tools don't offer. If your events exist to serve members, advance professional development, and strengthen chapter engagement, general-purpose tools typically leave gaps that association-specific software is designed to fill. ";}s:6:"item-7";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:64:"Can association event software support virtual or hybrid events?";s:6:"answer";s:537:"Yes. Momentive supports in-person, virtual, and hybrid event formats, so associations can deliver consistent member experiences regardless of how attendees participate. Virtual and hybrid events include online registration and ticketing within the same platform your staff uses for in-person programs. You can expect a native event player for webcasting and live streaming, plus integrations with Zoom, GoToMeeting, GoToWebinar, and Adobe Connect. You can run events yourself or leverage Momentive's fully managed production services. a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:72:"What makes MIP Fund Accounting different from other accounting software?";s:6:"answer";s:215:"MIP is purpose-built for nonprofits, governments, and associations. With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

item.dc:creator: colleen.bernum@momentivestg.wpenginepowered.com
item.content:encoded:
• Accounting Software

Bring on Better Accounting Software

Explore our accounting software, reporting, and budgeting tools for mission-driven organizations. Speak with an Expert

Helping thousands of nonprofits, associations, and municipalities account for their futures.

Grow your mission with MIP Accounting.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Simplify financial management and ensure compliance with MIP Accounting.
Power your mission with better accounting

With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

Be audit-ready with MIP Accounting’s robust audit suite. From our built-in audit trail to internal controls and view-only licenses, we give your organization the tools to ace your financial audits.

Have questions about MIP Fund Accounting? We’ve got answers. Learn how MIP simplifies your financial management, integrates with your systems, and supports your organization’s mission.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:72:"What makes MIP Fund Accounting different from other accounting software?";s:6:"answer";s:215:"MIP is purpose-built for nonprofits, governments, and associations. It provides unlimited fund tracking, compliance-focused tools, and customizable reporting to meet the unique needs of mission-driven organizations.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:57:"Can MIP Fund Accounting integrate with my existing tools?";s:6:"answer";s:173:"Yes, MIP integrates seamlessly with CRMs, HR platforms, donor management systems, and fundraising tools such as GiveSmart. This ensures smooth data flow across your systems.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:70:"Does MIP support compliance with nonprofit and government regulations?";s:6:"answer";s:128:"Absolutely. MIP includes tools for automated compliance reporting, ensuring you meet FASB, GASB, and other regulatory standards.";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:58:"Is MIP Fund Accounting scalable for growing organizations?";s:6:"answer";s:175:"Yes! MIP is designed to grow with your organization, whether you’re managing a small nonprofit or a large government entity. Its flexible tools adapt to your evolving needs.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:53:"What are the pricing options for MIP Fund Accounting?";s:6:"answer";s:157:"MIP offers flexible pricing based on your organization's size, goals, and services required. Contact us to discuss your needs and receive a customized quote.";}}
Connected systems, unified data, better decisions

MIP Fund Accounting connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, ensuring consistent data flow and simplified operations. Whether it’s your GiveSmart Fundraising & Events, CRM, HR, or financial systems, MIP provides seamless integration to unify your processes and deliver a comprehensive view of your organization’s financial health.

Account more. Report more. Thrive more.

Momentive’s MIP Accounting handles intricate financial processes and supports finance operations to boost efficiency, improve visibility, and bolster operations. Bring on Better for your organization’s finances.

• Home

  • Certification Management

Certification Management Software

Streamline certification.
Elevate certificant value.

Momentive Certification Management Software empowers associations and credentialing bodies to deliver scalable, compliant, and engaging certification programs—simplifying the full lifecycle, from application to renewal.

Speak with an Expert

Trusted by credentialing bodies internationally

What is Certification Management Software?

Certification Management Software is a purpose-built platform that helps organizations manage the full lifecycle of professional credentials. From eligibility and application to renewal and compliance, it centralizes operations and enhances the  certificant experience.

Deliver more value with less complexity.

Momentive Certification Management Software helps you reduce operational friction, improve compliance, and deliver a seamless experience for certificants.

Automated eligibility checks, renewal tracking, and real-time reports and analytics for you to easily assess your program’s growth and goals and ensure your certifications meet regulatory standards and accreditation requirements. Provide a modern, intuitive portal where certificants can apply, renew, and track their progress—on any device, at any time. Automate approvals, reminders, CE tracking, and more. Free your staff from manual tasks and focus on strategic growth. Connect your certification workflows with exam platforms, digital badging, LMS, and AMS tools. Eliminate silos and create a unified experience for staff and members. Stay ahead of certificant expectations with AI-powered tools, deep integrations, and a flexible platform that grows with your organization. Kicker here

"What I like about [GiveSmart] is that things don't fall through the cracks, unlike when you have multiple spreadsheets and multiple places that people need to look for information...if it's automated it just happens, and GiveSmart allows us to have most of it in one place ...  that has been really essential knowing that it's all in one place." Kelly J. Littleton Public Schools Foundation "Our work with Momentive has been highly effective at showing student and graduating members the value of continued membership with SACNAS. The results have been fantastic, and they get better every year." Daniela Bernal Communications and Membership Manager Society for Advancement of Chicanos/Hispanics and Native Americans in Science (SACNAS) "Momentive’s partnership provided a dozen banners and drafted several emails targeting employers and job seekers registered on the AWIS Career Center. They did all this so we can focus on promoting the career fair to our members, lapsed members, contacts in our database, and new prospects via social media. We were very pleased with the results. This is the impact we were hoping to have." Shelley O’Brien Chief Marketing Officer, AWIS "The solution helps us make our career center a better offering for our members while driving more non-dues revenue from it – all without extra work on our part." Lauren San Martin Marketing and Membership Director, VECCS "As soon as we kicked off the implementation, the Momentive team was amazing. Our Project Manager kept us on track with weekly check-ins. Everyone was amazing and really responsive. We did the implementation through holding our annual conference with 1000 delegates. The team did an excellent job of working around those blackout dates. It was not stressful at all, and we finished with time to spare." Christina Bova Director, Member Engagement and Advocacy, CAEP  "The entire team is really happy to be with Momentive’s Netforum, from our Executive Director to accounting to committees, membership management, fellowship, fundraising and donations. This is changing our world." Kerry Lennon Business Analyst and Technology Manager, AOA "Having the systems all integrate saves time and money because if the two systems can talk to each other, you’re not going in and doing any intervention or making sure it’s working. Volunteer Management Software

Volunteer Management Software for Scheduling &  Engagement

Boost volunteer engagement and management with our best-in-class volunteer management software and focus more on your core mission. Speak with an Expert

Trusted by organizations to amplify every volunteer program

Volunteer management software trusted by hundreds of organizations.

Make it easy for volunteers to find your projects...

VolunteerMatters has helped countless organizations scale and manage large volumes of volunteers, increasing efficiency  and impact.

Our software has enabled nonprofits to save time, engage thousands of volunteers more effectively, and streamline operations, ultimately allowing them to focus on their core mission.

Save time with our volunteer management system features.

VolunteerMatters is more than just a volunteer management tool — its powerful volunteer onboarding, management, and engagement features connect you more with the people who fuel your mission.

Get everything from project catalogs to dedicated landing pages and social media tools to boost outreach efforts, along with targeted e-mail and text recruitment to connect volunteers with initiatives they’ll be interested in. Manage all states of volunteer onboarding, including automating liability waivers, enforcing background checks, managing document verification, facilitating training sessions, integrating reference checks, and more. Access various templates for sending automated texts and e-mails as timely reminders and feedback requests. Keep one step ahead with our streamlined self-registration system, where volunteers can search and sign up for opportunities on their own. An automated onboarding workflow handles registration and verification, as well, significantly reducing administrative workload. Our platform makes feedback collection quick and easy. Volunteers will receive a short survey via e-mail with three simple questions after each volunteer assignment is completed. Kicker here

We have never felt like we’re a number or a sales goal." Allison Walsh "It helps us keep accurate financial records, which is extremely useful for our annual audit. It accommodates as many GL codes and departments as you need to maintain detailed, accurate records." Administrator "One of the best accounting systems I have implemented and used. Better accounts management between the campus and auxiliary departments — reliable connections, all the time." Director of Information Technology "The more familiar I become, the more I enjoy the software — it's very well designed and easy to tailor to your industry needs." Brenda C. "There are features that have helped us strengthen our audit compliance. Even new users — including student workers we train each semester — are able to quickly learn to use the system." Tim Warren "Text messaging proved to be just as important as our other marketing channels like direct mail and email marketing." Heather K. "I really enjoy MIP. It makes my life easier. I’m not having to manipulate data in order to get information to present. I truly can pull financials out of the system and then make pretty charts out of them for my board. It’s always meeting my needs." Christina P. "With EWS, employees now log their hours in the system and supervisors approve them online. There’s no manual entry required, and the data is automatically shared with MIP." Cindy Lewis "EWS saves the Payroll team a day and a half worth of time every single pay period." Kimberly Terry

Bring on Better
Donor Stewardship

Do more with our smart, modern donor management software and a partner invested in your success. Speak with an Expert

Helping thousands of nonprofits and other organizations track, manage, and steward their donors.

Grow your revenue with GiveSmart.

Make your mission a movement with our donor management software

Gain access to all our donor management tools, from donor search and dashboards to automated thank yous, easy gift entry, and everything in between, so you can better engage your donors.

Donor management tools that work together 

Simplify retention, thank donors the right way, and gain visibility with GiveSmart. Our donor management tools and features equip your team to engage your supporters year-round and keep them giving.

Access giving potential, better track pledges, and gain a centralized view of every donor interaction for smarter donor retention. Our easy activity tracking and at-a-glance relationship timeline for each supporter drives strong,  strategic stewardship and engagement. Automated thank you letters and receipts enhance  compliance, efficiency, and your organization’s relationships with its donors. Our powerful querying and filtering, combined with our dashboards, provide insights for smarter decision-making. Kicker here

No data was found "What I like about [GiveSmart] is that things don't fall through the cracks, unlike when you have multiple spreadsheets and multiple places that people need to look for information...if it's automated it just happens, and GiveSmart allows us to have most of it in one place ...  that has been really essential knowing that it's all in one place." Kelly J. Littleton Public Schools Foundation "Our work with Momentive has been highly effective at showing student and graduating members the value of continued membership with SACNAS. The results have been fantastic, and they get better every year." Daniela Bernal Communications and Membership Manager Society for Advancement of Chicanos/Hispanics and Native Americans in Science (SACNAS) "Momentive’s partnership provided a dozen banners and drafted several emails targeting employers and job seekers registered on the AWIS Career Center. They did all this so we can focus on promoting the career fair to our members, lapsed members, contacts in our database, and new prospects via social media. We were very pleased with the results. This is the impact we were hoping to have." Shelley O’Brien Chief Marketing Officer, AWIS "The solution helps us make our career center a better offering for our members while driving more non-dues revenue from it – all without extra work on our part." a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:56:"What is a nonprofit LMS and why do nonprofits need one? ";s:6:"answer";s:481:"A nonprofit LMS is a specialized learning management system designed to meet the unique needs of mission-driven organizations, such as staff onboarding, volunteer training, and continuing education. Nonprofits need a dedicated platform like Path LMS to deliver impactful, scalable education programs that advance their mission without the complexity or high costs associated with traditional enterprise software. ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:64:"How can Path LMS support staff and volunteer training programs? ";s:6:"answer";s:474:"Path LMS streamlines the onboarding process by providing structured learning paths and automated enrollment for new team members. You can easily track course completions, send automated reminders, and provide personalized learner portals, ensuring that your distributed staff and volunteers have the consistent knowledge they need to serve your community effectively. ";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:72:"Can nonprofits use Path LMS to generate revenue from education programs?";s:6:"answer";s:412:"Yes. Beyond internal training, Path LMS allows your organization to monetize its expertise by offering external courses and certificate programs, creating a valuable stream of non-dues revenue that can be reinvested into your programs, all while providing professional development opportunities to your broader industry or community. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:75:"Does Path LMS integrate with nonprofit management and fundraising software?";s:6:"answer";s:387:"Path LMS is built to work seamlessly within your existing ecosystem, allowing you to capture attendance automatically and measure the impact of your programs with real-time data. By connecting your learning data with your broader management tools, you can generate comprehensive reports for board presentations, grant applications, and internal strategic planning with just a few clicks.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:65:"How easy is it to get started with Path LMS as a small nonprofit?";s:6:"answer";s:394:"Path LMS is designed to be intuitive and user-friendly, even for those without a technical background. The platform makes it easy to transfer content and build courses quickly, allowing smaller teams to launch professional learning programs in a fraction of the time. Additionally, the flexible nature of the software means it can scale alongside your organization as your training needs grow. ";}}

Helping thousands of nonprofits, associations, and municipalities account for their futures.

Grow your mission with MIP Accounting.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Deliver continuing education, grow non-dues revenue, and keep members engaged with a learning management platform built specifically for associations.
Power your mission with better accounting

With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.
Smarter continuing education and member learning for associations

Associations are the go-to resource for professional development in their industry, but delivering scalable, engaging education is harder than it should be. Path LMS gives associations the tools to build world-class learning programs without adding strain to your team.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:85:"What is an association LMS and how is it different from a general learning platform? ";s:6:"answer";s:505:"An association LMS is a specialized learning management system designed to meet the specific needs of professional organizations, such as managing continuing education (CE) credits, certifications, and non-dues revenue. Unlike general corporate platforms meant for internal employee training, an association LMS like Path LMS is built to deliver external-facing content, manage complex accreditation requirements, and integrate directly with member databases to provide a personalized learner experience. ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:77:"How does Path LMS help associations grow non-dues revenue through education? ";s:6:"answer";s:391:"Path LMS provides dedicated non-dues revenue tools that allow your association to monetize its expertise. You can easily sell courses, certifications, and premium content to both members and non-members. The platform supports tiered pricing, allowing you to offer member-only discounts or specialized corporate packages, all while tracking revenue performance through a real-time dashboard. ";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:80:"Can Path LMS manage CE credits and accreditation requirements for associations? ";s:6:"answer";s:358:"Yes. Path LMS is purpose-built to automate the heavy lifting of professional development. The platform automates credit tracking, certificate generation, and transcript management for your members. This ensures that learners can seamlessly document their achievements and fulfill their CE requirements while reducing the administrative burden on your staff. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:66:"How does Path LMS integrate with association management software? ";s:6:"answer";s:449:"Path LMS is designed to provide a seamless integration with your Association Management Software (AMS) and existing member data. This connectivity ensures that member records, course completions, and credit hours are synchronized across your systems. By bridging these platforms, you can provide a unified experience where members can access their personalized learner portals and track their progress without navigating between disconnected tools. ";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:79:"What kind of support does Momentive provide for association learning programs? ";s:6:"answer";s:460:"Momentive Software provides expert guidance to help associations build and scale world-class learning programs. From the initial implementation to ongoing technical support, we partner with your team to ensure your education library stays fresh and relevant. Our focus is on providing a platform that empowers your finance and education teams with the reporting and analytics needed to prove the impact of your programs to your board and accreditation bodies. ";}}

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Delivering trusted career growth services that engage members and grow revenue.
Power your mission with better accounting

With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.
Bring on Better Career Opportunities for your Members

Associations are uniquely positioned to connect members with the right career opportunities, but only if your job board is built to support that mission. YM Careers gives organizations the tools to deliver a modern, revenue-generating career center without the administrative burden.

Exclusive access reinforces the value of membership and keeps members engaged with your association throughout their careers.";s:9:"link_text";s:7:"Explore";s:4:"link";s:74:"https://momentivesoftware.com/solutions/career-centers-software/job-board/";s:13:"outbound_link";s:4:"true";}s:6:"item-1";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:12:"box-bx-money";s:5:"title";s:50:"Non-dues revenue through employer job posting fees";s:11:"description";s:222:"Turn your career center into a reliable revenue stream. Employers pay to post jobs and reach your highly qualified, industry-specific member audience — generating income that directly supports your association's mission.";s:9:"link_text";s:7:"Explore";s:4:"link";s:81:"https://momentivesoftware.com/solutions/career-centers-software/non-dues-revenue/";s:13:"outbound_link";s:4:"true";}s:6:"item-2";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:19:"box-bx-shape-circle";s:5:"title";s:50:"Seamless integration with your AMS and member data";s:11:"description";s:471:"YM Careers connects natively with YourMembership AMS, Nimble AMS, and other solutions in the Momentive Software family, so member access levels, credentials, and permissions stay in sync, without manual data entry or duplicate records.";s:9:"link_text";s:7:"Explore";s:4:"link";s:76:"https://momentivesoftware.com/solutions/career-centers-software/integration/";s:13:"outbound_link";s:4:"true";}s:6:"item-3";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:15:"box-bx-category";s:5:"title";s:46:"Branded, customizable career center experience";s:11:"description";s:213:"Your career center should look and feel like yours. Fully customize the design, layout, and messaging so members and employers experience a cohesive, on-brand destination that reflects your association's identity.";s:9:"link_text";s:7:"Explore";s:4:"link";s:79:"https://momentivesoftware.com/solutions/career-centers-software/implementation/";s:13:"outbound_link";s:4:"true";}}

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:88:"What is association job board software, and how is it different from general job boards?";s:6:"answer";s:530:"Association job board software is purpose-built for member-based organizations, unlike generic platforms such as Indeed or LinkedIn. It connects members with industry-specific opportunities vetted through a trusted professional community. Access can be gated by membership status, postings are curated for your industry, and the platform is fully branded to your association — creating an experience that reinforces the value of belonging.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:65:"How does a career center help associations grow non-dues revenue?";s:6:"answer";s:476:"Employers pay to post positions and reach your highly targeted, credentialed membership base. Career Center software by Momentive enables tiered pricing for standard listings, featured placements, and employer packages — giving your association a flexible, scalable revenue stream that doesn't rely on dues alone. Many associations see meaningful revenue growth in their first year after launch.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:51:"Does the job board integrate with our existing AMS?";s:6:"answer";s:368:"Yes. Momentive Career Center integrates natively with AMS solutions within the Momentive family. Member records, access permissions, and data stay synchronized automatically, reducing staff burden and ensuring members always see the right content based on their membership status. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:65:"Can we brand and customize the career center for our association?";s:6:"answer";s:272:"Absolutely. Career Center is fully customizable — from colors, logos, and fonts to page layouts and messaging. Your members and employers will experience a career center that feels like a natural extension of your association's website and brand, not a third-party tool.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:81:"What kind of support and onboarding does Momentive provide for the Career Center?";s:6:"answer";s:329:"Momentive provides dedicated implementation services, a structured onboarding process, and ongoing support from a team with nearly 200 years of combined experience in association technology. Whether you're launching a brand-new career center or migrating from another platform, Momentive's team is with you every step of the way.";}}
Connected systems, unified data, better decisions

MIP Fund Accounting connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, ensuring consistent data flow and simplified operations. Whether it’s your GiveSmart Fundraising & Events, CRM, HR, or financial systems, MIP provides seamless integration to unify your processes and deliver a comprehensive view of your organization’s financial health.

Association Management Software

Association Management Software to Grow and Engage Members

The best association management software for all organizations—no matter your size, membership complexity, or goals. 

[hubspot_form_embed]

Trusted by association professionals worldwide 

Join thousands of organizations choosing Momentive.

Solutions tailored to  your association’s  unique needs

From small and growing organizations to large and established associations, Momentive’s association management solutions scale to meet your unique challenges. Whether it’s streamlining member management, automating operations, or enhancing engagement, our tools are built to empower your mission.

Streamline operations. Engage members. Drive growth.

Momentive’s association management software empowers you to do more with less.

Unlock tools designed to simplify recruitment, reduce churn, and strengthen member engagement. Avoid one-size-fits-all limitations by choosing an AMS that meets your unique association’s goals. Turn engagement into income with tools that maximize sponsorship visibility and value. Trusted by thousands of associations to deliver measurable results and member impact. Kicker here

Helping organizations build better

"We are super appreciative of Momentive’s time and efforts into this event. It is so helpful to work with a team that is so reliable and quick to jump in whenever we need." Sinead G. Senior Specialist Strategic Partnerships, Society of Women Engineers "Rather than investing the time and gaining the experience that Momentive already has, you can focus on your core mission and know that Momentive has your back. It's a solution where you can go to the expert rather than try to become the expert." Greg M. Associate Publisher, ASHRAE Media Advertising "Andrew has been absolutely amazing. He not only supports us but teaches us how to use the system, which is invaluable for our team." Bonnie B. Administrative Coordinator, Motorcycle Industry Council "Truth be told, this is the one national conference where our whole industry comes together. It's more than an event. It's where real connections and decisions happen. We needed to allow people to select their booth, register easily, and manage participation on their own. A2Z just checked off most of the boxes." Jessica H. Senior Manager of Advertising Sponsorships and Partner Programs, National Association of Independent Schools "Andrew has been the best thing to happen to me with A2Z. I feel supported, heard, and valued ... I don't need another link. I need a person who understands what I'm asking and can help me get there — that's what A2Z gave me." Erika O-R. Director, Exhibits Sales and Meeting Services at the Aesthetic Society "I had a shortlist and knew what we needed. A2Z Events checked all the boxes, especially when it came to the ability of integration and ease of use." Kaylee G. Manager of Corporate Partner Engagement, College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) "The implementation has been very smooth. Jill has been incredibly helpful in answering questions and walking us through everything. She’s been great" Carrie T. Senior Manager of Digital Content and Member Operations, Council of Administrators of Special Education (CASE) "Why The American Mathematical Society choose [Momentive] was primarily the flexibility and customization ability that the product offered. ThreeSixty met a lot of our needs out of the box. But, we also had a lot that we needed to do ourselves. We have a lot of users that have really specific requirements, and we needed a product that would work with us and a team that would work with us." Jeff H. Director, Information Systems, American Mathematical Society "Path LMS became an arm of ACSM, not just a vendor. They took the extra time, care, and attention to learn about us, and they cared about what we were doing, and that made the difference—when you can tell that the people that you're working with care just as much as you do." Katherine S. VP of Operations, American College of Sports Medicine

• Home

Certification Management Software

Streamline certification.
Elevate certificant value.

Momentive Certification Management Software empowers associations and credentialing bodies to deliver scalable, compliant, and engaging certification programs—simplifying the full lifecycle, from application to renewal.

[hubspot_form_embed]

Trusted by credentialing bodies internationally

Join hundreds of organizations managing professional certification programs with Momentive.

What is Certification Management Software?

Certification Management Software is a purpose-built platform that helps organizations manage the full lifecycle of professional credentials. From eligibility and application to renewal and compliance, it centralizes operations and enhances the  certificant experience.

Deliver more value with less complexity.

Momentive Certification Management Software helps you reduce operational friction, improve compliance, and deliver a seamless experience for certificants.

Automated eligibility checks, renewal tracking, and real-time reports and analytics for you to easily assess your program’s growth and goals and ensure your certifications meet regulatory standards and accreditation requirements. Provide a modern, intuitive portal where certificants can apply, renew, and track their progress—on any device, at any time. Automate approvals, reminders, CE tracking, and more. Free your staff from manual tasks and focus on strategic growth. Connect your certification workflows with exam platforms, digital badging, LMS, and AMS tools. Eliminate silos and create a unified experience for staff and members. Stay ahead of certificant expectations with AI-powered tools, deep integrations, and a flexible platform that grows with your organization. Kicker here

Helping organizations build better

Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software

0

Built for certification success

Learn more Learn more Learn more Learn more Learn more Learn more Learn more Download now

A true partner for your organization

"We see [Momentive Certification Management] as one of our strongest partners. This was especially important during the pandemic. We had to quickly reconfigure various elements of our system and even think through some core operational changes. [Momentive Certification Management]’s solution is user-friendly and extremely adaptable, which made it simple to adapt to the new needs of our members. And our support at [Momentive Certification Management] served as strategic partners through it all – a true extension of our staff. " Charles Redding Chief Information Officer, The Institute for Internal Auditors "Working with [Momentive Certification Management] for over a decade has been a truly collaborative experience. Their ability to continuously customize and improve our system to meet our specific needs has made a significant impact on our operations. From seamless data integration to innovative product bundling, [their] solutions have empowered us to better serve our credentialing candidates and stakeholders." Jasamine Riel Certification Products Manager, Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB)

a:12:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:36:"What is event registration software?";s:6:"answer";s:617:"Event registration software is a digital platform that manages how attendees sign up, pay, and check in for events. It replaces manual processes like spreadsheets, email threads, and paper forms with an online registration workflow that handles attendee sign-ups, ticketing, payment processing, automated confirmations, and post-event reporting — all from one system.
For event teams running conferences, trade shows, fundraising galas, or member meetings, event registration software streamlines logistics, reduces staff workload, and creates a smoother experience for attendees from the moment they register. ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:66:"What features should I look for in an event registration platform?";s:6:"answer";s:627:"The most effective event registration platforms go beyond basic sign-up forms. Look for features that address the full registration lifecycle: customizable registration forms with support for multiple attendee types, flexible pricing tiers and discount codes, secure payment processing, mobile-responsive registration pages, branded design options, and real-time reporting dashboards.
Integration capabilities matter too — your event registration platform should connect with your existing AMS, CRM, or donor management system so attendee data flows seamlessly across your technology stack without manual reconciliation. ";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:67:"Can event registration software handle multiple registration types?";s:6:"answer";s:351:"Yes. Momentive's event registration platform supports distinct registration paths for attendees, speakers, exhibitors, and volunteers. You can offer early-bird pricing, group discounts, membership-based rates, and promo codes, all within a single registration workflow, giving your team full visibility into totals for logistics and budget planning. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:80:"Does Momentive's event registration software integrate with AMS and CRM systems?";s:6:"answer";s:678:"Yes. Momentive's event registration software is built to connect with the tools your organization already uses. It supports single sign-on and membership discounts for most AMS and CRM systems, so returning members can log in with their existing credentials and automatically receive the correct pricing.
Registration data syncs with your member or donor records, eliminating the need to manually export and reconcile data across platforms. For organizations within the Momentive’s event management ecosystem, event registration connects directly with association management, fundraising, and donor management solutions for a unified view of attendee and member activity. ";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:73:"Does registration need to close before event day to prepare for check-in?";s:6:"answer";s:412:"No. Because Momentive's registration data integrates directly with onsite check-in and badge printing, you don't need to close registration weeks in advance to prepare. Sign-ups can stay live longer, capturing last-minute attendees without adding operational risk. Real-time membership verification runs automatically during registration, so everyone receives the correct pricing regardless of when they sign up.";}s:6:"item-5";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:47:"Is event registration software mobile-friendly?";s:6:"answer";s:592:"It should be — and with Momentive, it is. A registration page that works well on phones and tablets helps ensure you aren't losing potential attendees due to a frustrating experience on smaller screens. Attendees can register whether they're on the go or at a desktop — without any difference in functionality. ";}s:6:"item-8";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:69:"How does event registration software reduce registration abandonment?";s:6:"answer";s:585:"Registration abandonment is a common challenge for event teams, and the right event registration software addresses it by simplifying the sign-up flow. ";}s:6:"item-9";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:70:"What reporting and analytics does event registration software provide?";s:6:"answer";s:565:"Momentive's event registration software includes real-time reporting and exportable analytics across every stage of your event. • Home

MomentiveIQ

Meet our new AI-powered platform designed specifically for nonprofits and associations to unify their technology ecosystem into an intelligent experience that delivers personalized engagement and actionable insights.

Speak with an expert

Innovation Built for Nonprofits and Associations

MomentiveIQ is an intelligent, unified platform that automates workflows, delivers personalized user experiences, and provides predictive insights across your entire ecosystem.
MomentiveIQ's advanced technology provides:

  • AI Agents that automate workflows and user interactions
  • AI-driven analytics surfacing predictive trends and opportunities
  • Personalized experiences tailored to each user journey
  • Industry-specific integrations with best-in-class security and governance

Explore Our Solutions

a:8:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:33:"What is nonprofit event software?";s:6:"answer";s:811:"Nonprofit event software is a platform built specifically to help mission-driven organizations plan, manage, and execute events — from fundraising galas and donor dinners to member meetings and community programs. It centralizes attendee registration, volunteer coordination, donation processing, and event reporting in one place. Unlike general-purpose event tools, nonprofit event software is designed for organizations with limited staff and volunteer-dependent teams. It reduces manual work, minimizes the risk of things falling through the cracks, and gives organizers visibility into event performance before, during, and after the event — so your team can focus on delivering impact rather than managing logistics. ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:77:"How does nonprofit event software support fundraising galas and donor events?";s:6:"answer";s:708:"Nonprofit event software brings together everything you need to drive attendance, collect donations, and measure results — without switching between platforms. Organizers can create branded registration pages, offer multiple ticket types and pricing tiers, and process payments securely to reduce registration abandonment. Built-in fundraising tools support auction management, sponsorship activation, and event-specific giving campaigns, so nonprofits can pursue multiple revenue streams within a single event. Real-time reporting lets staff monitor donations, attendance, and donor activity as the event unfolds — and those same insights feed directly into board reports and future event planning. ";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:86:"Can Momentive’s nonprofit event software handle volunteer and attendee registration?";s:6:"answer";s:828:"Yes — both are managed within a single system, with no need for separate tools. Volunteers can search available opportunities and sign up through a self-service portal, reducing coordination work for staff. Automated onboarding workflows handle document verification and compliance requirements — including liability waivers and background checks — without manual follow-up. Shift scheduling, check-in, and hour tracking are all built in, giving organizers a complete view of who is attending and who is working the event. For nonprofits running large-scale galas or community events with dozens of volunteers, this consolidated approach saves significant time and helps ensure the right people are in the right roles on event day.";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:84:"Does nonprofit event software integrate with donor management and fundraising tools?";s:6:"answer";s:817:"Yes. Most modern nonprofit event platforms offer native integrations or API connections to popular CRMs, donor databases, and fundraising tools — so event data doesn't live in a silo. Momentive takes this further by offering event management, donor management, and fundraising software within the same connected platform. Event registration data automatically updates donor profiles, contributions are linked to the right campaigns, and staff spend less time reconciling data across systems. For organizations already using other tools, Momentive's event registration software supports single sign-on and membership discounts for most AMS and CRM systems.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:59:"What reporting is available for nonprofit event organizers?";s:6:"answer";s:671:"Momentive provides real-time reporting and analytics across every stage of your event. Organizers can track registration volume, revenue, donor activity, and attendee engagement — before, during, and after the event. Reports are exportable and customizable for board presentations and stakeholder updates. During the event, live dashboards give staff visibility into check-in progress, donation totals, and session attendance. After the event, that data supports analysis of what worked, where revenue came from, and how donor engagement trended over time — giving nonprofits the evidence they need to justify event investments and make data-backed improvements. ";}s:6:"item-5";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:93:"What's the difference between nonprofit event software and general event management software?";s:6:"answer";s:854:"General event management software is built for a broad range of use cases — conferences, trade shows, corporate meetings — and focuses primarily on logistics like registration and scheduling. Nonprofit event software is purpose-built for the specific workflows nonprofits rely on: fundraising, donor tracking, volunteer management, and impact reporting. The key differences are in what happens around the event itself. Nonprofit event software connects event data to donor records and giving history, supports fundraising-specific tools like auction management and campaign-linked donations, and provides reporting that helps organizations demonstrate impact to boards and funders. If your events exist to raise money or deepen donor relationships, general-purpose tools typically leave gaps that nonprofit-specific software is designed to fill. ";}s:6:"item-6";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:62:"Can nonprofit event software support virtual or hybrid events?";s:6:"answer";s:510:"Yes. Many nonprofit event platforms — including Momentive — support in-person, virtual, and hybrid event formats. This includes virtual registration and ticketing, livestream integration, and online donation collection so remote attendees can participate and give in real time. For nonprofits with geographically dispersed supporters or donors who can't attend in person, hybrid capabilities expand your event's reach and fundraising potential without requiring a completely separate technology stack. ";}s:6:"item-7";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:44:"How much does nonprofit event software cost?";s:6:"answer";s:472:"Pricing varies depending on the platform, the size of your events, and the features you need. Some providers charge per event or per registrant, while others offer annual subscriptions with tiered pricing based on functionality. Momentive offers tailored pricing based on your organization's needs. To get a quote or see how pricing works for your specific use case, request a demo and speak with a member of our team. ";}}

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:65:"What is nonprofit payroll software and why do nonprofits need it?";s:6:"answer";s:416:"Nonprofit payroll software is a specialized tool designed to handle the unique financial requirements of mission-driven organizations, such as fund accounting integration and grant-based payroll allocation. Nonprofits need these tools to ensure that every dollar is tracked accurately, helping them maintain transparency for donors and stay compliant with strict regulatory standards while paying their team on time.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:66:"How does MIP People handle payroll tax compliance for nonprofits? ";s:6:"answer";s:349:"MIP People simplifies tax compliance by providing both paper and e-filing options. The system helps your organization stay current with tax regulations and automate the generation of necessary HR reporting for ACA, FMLA, and EEO forms. This reduces the risk of manual errors and ensures your sensitive data is handled with the highest level of care.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:71:"Can nonprofit payroll software integrate with fund accounting systems? ";s:6:"answer";s:371:"Yes, and this integration is a core strength of MIP. MIP People is designed to work seamlessly with our fund accounting modules, generating fully allocated accounting entries and ensuring that payroll data flows directly into your general ledger. This eliminates the need for manual data entry and provides a real-time, centralized view of your organization’s finances.";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:66:"How does MIP People support benefit enrollment and HR management? ";s:6:"answer";s:364:"The system takes the complexity out of managing employee data by tracking certifications, education, and benefit plan adjustments in one central location. It offers a self-guided portal where staff can review their current benefits and make future elections, which ensures accurate selections and a better overall experience for both the employee and the HR team. ";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:70:"Does MIP People offer employee self-service tools for nonprofit staff?";s:6:"answer";s:334:"Through Employee Web Services (EWS), your team gains round-the-clock access to their own timesheets, pay stubs, and HR messages. By empowering employees to manage their own information and log hours online, you can free up your finance and HR teams from routine administrative requests and allow them to focus on more strategic work. ";}}
Connected systems, unified data, better decisions

MIP Fund Accounting connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, ensuring consistent data flow and simplified operations. Whether it’s your GiveSmart Fundraising & Events, CRM, HR, or financial systems, MIP provides seamless integration to unify your processes and deliver a comprehensive view of your organization’s financial health.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:70:"How is Momentive school accounting software different from QuickBooks?";s:6:"answer";s:402:"QuickBooks was built for businesses with a single bottom line. School finance is more complex, including categorical funds, federal grants, state allocations, and compliance reporting that changes every year. Momentive's fund accounting solution is purpose-built for that complexity, with a flexible chart of accounts, built-in GASB compliance, and 150+ report templates designed for education finance.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:77:"What federal grant tracking and Title I compliance capabilities are included?";s:6:"answer";s:382:"The Grants Administration module tracks Title I, Title II, IDEA, and other federal funding streams, along with their budgets, expenditures, and compliance requirements — all in one system. It supports Single Audit compliance under 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), and the Allocations Management module automates indirect cost distribution and generates corresponding GL entries.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:52:"Is Momentive fund accounting available in the cloud?";s:6:"answer";s:331:"Yes, in three configurations. Cloud Modern is a true SaaS product accessible from any web browser, with automatic updates and enterprise-grade security. Cloud Classic is a hosted remote desktop option. On-Premises is available for districts that require full on-site data control. Cloud Modern is recommended for new deployments. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:95:"Does Momentive fund accounting for schools support GASB standards for educational institutions?";s:6:"answer";s:275:"Yes. The platform supports both GASB and FASB reporting, making it suitable for public school districts and charter schools alike. GASB-compliant financial statements, fund-level reporting, and the required disclosures for governmental and proprietary funds are all built in.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:77:"Does Momentive fund accounting integrate with the broader Momentive platform?";s:6:"answer";s:370:"Yes. As part of the Momentive platform, fund accounting connects directly with association management, learning management, and event management, providing institutions with a unified technology ecosystem. It also integrates with GiveSmart for fundraising, Momentive Automated Payments powered by Corpay, Microix Workflow, DrillPoint Reports, and AvidPay by AvidXchange.";}}
Connected systems, unified data, better decisions

MIP Fund Accounting connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, ensuring consistent data flow and simplified operations. Whether it’s your GiveSmart Fundraising & Events, CRM, HR, or financial systems, MIP provides seamless integration to unify your processes and deliver a comprehensive view of your organization’s financial health.

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:68:"What is a healthcare LMS and how is it different from a general LMS?";s:6:"answer";s:549:"A healthcare LMS is a specialized learning management system designed to handle the rigorous regulatory and accreditation requirements of the medical field. Unlike a general LMS, a healthcare-specific platform like Path LMS includes native functionality for managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Continuing Nursing Education (CNE) credits, tracking complex compliance deadlines, and supporting the specific content formats required for clinical training. ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:61:"Can Path LMS support CME and CNE accreditation requirements? ";s:6:"answer";s:419:"Yes. Path LMS is built to align with the standards set by major accrediting bodies. The platform allows healthcare organizations to automate the workflows required for accreditation, ensuring that course materials, assessments, and time-tracking meet the specific criteria needed to award official CME and CNE credits to participants. ";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:71:"How does Path LMS handle CE credit tracking and transcript generation? ";s:6:"answer";s:497:"The system automates the entire credit lifecycle. Once a healthcare professional completes a required course or attends a qualifying live event, Path LMS calculates the earned credits and updates the learner’s profile in real time. Professionals can then access a personalized portal to download official, audit-ready transcripts and certificates without any manual intervention from your administrative staff. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:64:"Can healthcare professionals access training on mobile devices? ";s:6:"answer";s:374:"Absolutely. We recognize that healthcare professionals often need to complete training during shifts or while on the go. Path LMS is fully responsive, providing a seamless learning experience across desktops, tablets, and smartphones. This flexibility ensures high completion rates by allowing users to access critical updates or CE courses whenever their schedule permits. ";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:77:"Does Path LMS integrate with association management or certification systems?";s:6:"answer";s:329:"Yes. To eliminate data silos, Path LMS integrates with leading Association Management Systems (AMS) and certification platforms. This ensures that member data, course completions, and credit totals sync automatically across your entire technology stack, providing a "single source of truth" for both your staff and your members. ";}}
Path LMS by Momentive Software is the healthcare LMS platform healthcare organizations need to run accredited, scalable continuing education programs without adding headcount or complexity.

• Home

Volunteer Management Software

Volunteer Management Software for Scheduling &  Engagement

Boost volunteer engagement and management with our best-in-class volunteer management software and focus more on your core mission.

[hubspot_form_embed]

Trusted by organizations to amplify every volunteer program

Volunteer management software trusted by hundreds of organizations.

Make it easy for volunteers to find your projects...

VolunteerMatters has helped countless organizations scale and manage large volumes of volunteers, increasing efficiency  and impact.

Our software has enabled nonprofits to save time, engage thousands of volunteers more effectively, and streamline operations, ultimately allowing them to focus on their core mission.

Save time with our volunteer management system features.

VolunteerMatters is more than just a volunteer management tool — its powerful volunteer onboarding, management, and engagement features connect you more with the people who fuel your mission.

Get everything from project catalogs to dedicated landing pages and social media tools to boost outreach efforts, along with targeted e-mail and text recruitment to connect volunteers with initiatives they’ll be interested in. Manage all states of volunteer onboarding, including automating liability waivers, enforcing background checks, managing document verification, facilitating training sessions, integrating reference checks, and more. Access various templates for sending automated texts and e-mails as timely reminders and feedback requests. Keep one step ahead with our streamlined self-registration system, where volunteers can search and sign up for opportunities on their own. An automated onboarding workflow handles registration and verification, as well, significantly reducing administrative workload. Our platform makes feedback collection quick and easy. Volunteers will receive a short survey via e-mail with three simple questions after each volunteer assignment is completed. Kicker here

"We are super appreciative of Momentive’s time and efforts into this event. It is so helpful to work with a team that is so reliable and quick to jump in whenever we need." Sinead G. Senior Specialist Strategic Partnerships, Society of Women Engineers "Rather than investing the time and gaining the experience that Momentive already has, you can focus on your core mission and know that Momentive has your back. It's a solution where you can go to the expert rather than try to become the expert." Greg M. Associate Publisher, ASHRAE Media Advertising "Andrew has been absolutely amazing. He not only supports us but teaches us how to use the system, which is invaluable for our team." Bonnie B. Administrative Coordinator, Motorcycle Industry Council "Truth be told, this is the one national conference where our whole industry comes together. It's more than an event. It's where real connections and decisions happen. We needed to allow people to select their booth, register easily, and manage participation on their own. A2Z just checked off most of the boxes." Jessica H. Senior Manager of Advertising Sponsorships and Partner Programs, National Association of Independent Schools "Andrew has been the best thing to happen to me with A2Z. I feel supported, heard, and valued ... I don't need another link. I need a person who understands what I'm asking and can help me get there — that's what A2Z gave me." Erika O-R. Director, Exhibits Sales and Meeting Services at the Aesthetic Society "I had a shortlist and knew what we needed. A2Z Events checked all the boxes, especially when it came to the ability of integration and ease of use." Kaylee G. Manager of Corporate Partner Engagement, College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) "The implementation has been very smooth. Jill has been incredibly helpful in answering questions and walking us through everything. She’s been great" Carrie T. Senior Manager of Digital Content and Member Operations, Council of Administrators of Special Education (CASE) "Why The American Mathematical Society choose [Momentive] was primarily the flexibility and customization ability that the product offered. ThreeSixty met a lot of our needs out of the box. But, we also had a lot that we needed to do ourselves. We have a lot of users that have really specific requirements, and we needed a product that would work with us and a team that would work with us." Jeff H. Director, Information Systems, American Mathematical Society "Path LMS became an arm of ACSM, not just a vendor. They took the extra time, care, and attention to learn about us, and they cared about what we were doing, and that made the difference—when you can tell that the people that you're working with care just as much as you do." Katherine S. VP of Operations, American College of Sports Medicine

Helping thousands of nonprofits, associations, and municipalities account for their futures.

Grow your mission with MIP Accounting.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Simplify financial management and ensure compliance with MIP Accounting.
Power your mission with better accounting

With MIP Fund Accounting, your organization can simplify operations, ensure compliance, and focus on what matters most: funding and achieving your mission. If you’re ready to explore the platform or want to speak with an expert, we’re here to help you get started.

a:2:{s:6:"item-0";a:5:{s:13:"number_prefix";s:0:"";s:6:"number";s:4:"5000";s:13:"number_suffix";s:1:"+";s:11:"description";s:64:"Mission-driven organizations rely on MIP’s accounting software";s:12:"accent_color";s:7:"#f26522";}s:6:"item-1";a:5:{s:13:"number_prefix";s:0:"";s:6:"number";s:2:"40";s:13:"number_suffix";s:1:"%";s:11:"description";s:63:"Faster task performance and completion of core accounting tasks";s:12:"accent_color";s:7:"#6a4ed8";}}
Bring on better financial clarity for your mission

When you're managing grants, donations, and program revenue in general accounting software, workarounds become a full-time job. Momentive's fund accounting solution is built for the complexity of nonprofit finance — so your team can focus on the mission.

a:4:{s:6:"item-0";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:19:"box-bx-category-alt";s:5:"title";s:56:"Fund accounting flexibility and unlimited grant tracking";s:11:"description";s:178:"A fully flexible and customizable chart of accounts that tracks every fund, grant, and program — structured around your organization, with no workarounds or shortcuts required.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-1";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:14:"box-bx-receipt";s:5:"title";s:30:"Compliance and audit readiness";s:11:"description";s:208:"Multi-level access controls, automatic inter-fund entries, and tamper-evident audit logging keep your organization aligned with FASB, GASB, and GAAP, so your team is always prepared when audit season arrives.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-2";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:17:"box-bx-chalkboard";s:5:"title";s:32:"Board and funder-ready reporting";s:11:"description";s:212:"Choose from 150+ built-in report templates to produce grant progress reports, FASB-compliant financials, 990 worksheets, and custom board packages. Schedule automated delivery to every stakeholder who needs them.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}s:6:"item-3";a:6:{s:4:"icon";s:10:"box-bx-cog";s:5:"title";s:25:"Automation for lean teams";s:11:"description";s:198:"Automated payments, bank reconciliation, budget alerts, and payroll cost allocation eliminate manual busywork. Save your team 520 hours per year and put that time back where it belongs: the mission.";s:9:"link_text";s:0:"";s:4:"link";s:0:"";s:13:"outbound_link";s:5:"false";}}

a:5:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:59:"How is Momentive fund accounting different from QuickBooks?";s:6:"answer";s:367:"QuickBooks is built for businesses with a single bottom line, not nonprofits managing restricted funds, grants, and compliance. Momentive's fund accounting solution is purpose-built for mission-driven organizations, with a fully flexible chart of accounts, 150+ built-in nonprofit reports, and native payroll integration that general-purpose software doesn’t offer.";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:69:"What grant tracking and federal compliance capabilities are included?";s:6:"answer";s:345:"The Grants Administration module tracks unlimited grants, including budgets, expenditures, and compliance requirements in a single system. It supports federal Single Audit compliance under 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), and the Allocations Management module automates cost distribution across grants, generating the corresponding GL entries.";}s:6:"item-2";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:52:"Is Momentive fund accounting available in the cloud?";s:6:"answer";s:358:"Yes, in three configurations. Cloud Modern is a true SaaS product accessible from any web browser, with automatic updates and enterprise-grade security included. Cloud Classic is a hosted remote desktop option, and On-Premises is available for organizations that require full on-site data control. Cloud Modern is generally recommended for new deployments. ";}s:6:"item-3";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:47:"How long has Momentive been serving nonprofits?";s:6:"answer";s:319:"More than 40 years. The platform was purpose-built from day one for mission-driven organizations and today serves 6,000+ nonprofits, healthcare organizations, and associations across the country. TrustRadius has recognized it as a Top Rated product in 10 categories, including Nonprofit Accounting and Grant Management.";}s:6:"item-4";a:2:{s:8:"question";s:58:"Does Momentive fund accounting integrate with other tools?";s:6:"answer";s:379:"Yes. The platform connects to a wide range of third-party products via DEF file integration and a REST API. Key integrations include GiveSmart (fundraising and donor management), Momentive Automated Payments powered by Corpay, Microix Workflow, DrillPoint Reports, and AvidPay by AvidXchange — plus the full Momentive platform for associations, events, and learning management.";}}
Connected systems, unified data, better decisions

MIP Fund Accounting connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, ensuring consistent data flow and simplified operations.
